mapper.sql: case g.status when 0 then '草稿' when 1 then '待审核' when 2 then '已驳回' when 3 then '在售' when 4 then '锁定' when 5 then '已售出' when 6 then '已下架' else '未知状态' end
mapper.select: select g.id, g.seller_id as sellerId, u.name as sellerName, u.avatar as sellerAvatar, u.campus as sellerCampus, u.score_avg as sellerScoreAvg, u.review_count as sellerReviewCount, g.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, g.title, g.detail, g.price, g.old_price as oldPrice, g.quality, g.location, g.status, as statusDesc, g.cover, g.view_count as viewCount, g.favorite_count as favoriteCount, g.publish_time as publishTime, g.create_time as createTime, g.update_time as updateTime from goods g left join category c on g.category_id = c.id left join user u on g.seller_id = u.id where g.id = #{goodsId} limit 1

select g.id, g.seller_id as sellerId, g.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, g.title, g.detail, g.price, g.old_price as oldPrice, g.quality, g.location, g.status, as statusDesc, g.cover, g.reason, g.audit_admin_id as auditAdminId, g.audit_time as auditTime, g.publish_time as publishTime, g.view_count as viewCount, g.favorite_count as favoriteCount, g.lock_order_id as lockOrderId, g.create_time as createTime, g.update_time as updateTime from goods g left join category c on g.category_id = c.id where g.id = #{goodsId} and g.seller_id = #{sellerId} limit 1

select g.id, g.seller_id as sellerId, u.name as sellerName, u.student_no as sellerStudentNo, u.avatar as sellerAvatar, u.campus as sellerCampus, g.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, g.title, g.detail, g.price, g.old_price as oldPrice, g.quality, g.location, g.status, as statusDesc, g.cover, g.reason, g.audit_admin_id as auditAdminId, g.audit_time as auditTime, g.publish_time as publishTime, g.view_count as viewCount, g.favorite_count as favoriteCount, g.lock_order_id as lockOrderId, g.version, g.create_time as createTime, g.update_time as updateTime from goods g left join category c on g.category_id = c.id left join user u on g.seller_id = u.id where g.id = #{goodsId} limit 1
